channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Trump usa la sentencia del Supremo que cercena los derechos de las minorías para mejorar sus perspectivas electorales
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court's decision weakening the 1965 Voting Rights Act prompted Louisiana to postpone its May primary elections, disrupting the path to November's midterm legislative races. The move is seen as part of Trump's strategy to improve his electoral prospects by diminishing minority representation.

item.title: Rejeição de Messias cria atalho conservador ao Supremo
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Court and Davi Alcolumbre's signal that he will not schedule a new nomination before the election give the right an opportunity to build a majority on the STF if they win the 2026 presidential race. This could consolidate a conservative tilt on the Court, influencing rulings on abortion, guns, and identity policies.

item.title: Crise com Alcolumbre coloca em xeque avanço de pautas prioritárias de Lula no Congresso
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the STF and the overturning of Lula’s veto on the Dosimetria Bill, blamed on Senate President Davi Alcolumbre’s maneuvering, have triggered a crisis threatening the advancement of key government priorities, including the 6x1 workweek reduction and the Security PEC. While allies see electoral momentum to push for shorter workweeks, there is concern that Congress may seize the issue and sidestep the executive’s proposal.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sobe no salto e mostra que já se considera eleito
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro shows confidence in his candidacy following bolsonarist victories in Congress, including the historic rejection of a Supreme Court nomination and the overturning of Lula’s veto on a bill reducing penalties for coup plotters. The senator, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, positions himself as a central figure in the movement and already acts as if elected for 2026.

item.title: Novo Desenrola: o que já se sabe sobre a renegociação de dívidas que Lula apresenta na segunda
item.description: President Lula announced on national radio and TV the creation of the 'New Desenrola Brasil', a debt renegotiation program to be presented on Monday. The initiative aims to assist indebted Brazilians, though specific operational details have not yet been disclosed. The full article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Seis partidos na Câmara e cinco no Senado votaram 100% a favor da redução da pena dos condenados pelo 8 de janeiro
item.description: Congress overturned President Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill, reducing sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, including Jair Bolsonaro. In the Chamber, 318 deputies voted to overturn the veto, with six parties voting unanimously in favor (PL, PSDB, Novo, PRD, Cidadania and Missão). In the Senate, 49 senators approved the measure, with five parties unanimously favorable (PL, PSDB, Novo, União Brasil and Avante).

item.title: Após Congresso derrubar veto de Lula, discussão sobre redução de penas deve voltar ao Supremo
item.description: Congress overturned President Lula's veto on a bill reducing sentences for those convicted of coup-related acts, including former President Jair Bolsonaro. The law will now be promulgated and may face review at the Supreme Court. Legal experts argue there are no apparent constitutional flaws, as Congress acted within its legitimate legislative authority.

item.title: Cláudio Castro recorre ao TSE contra inelegibilidade de 8 anos
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) appealed to the TSE against his 8-year ineligibility, imposed for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections. His defense claims violations of due process, seeks annulment of the ruling, and requests modified effects to enable his Senate bid in 2026. Former Alerj president Rodrigo Bacellar filed a similar appeal to regain his state deputy seat.

item.title: Após crise com Lula, Alcolumbre deve dar aval a apoio de União e PP a Flávio
item.description: Leaders of the União Progressista federation (União Brasil/PP) believe Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) will not engage in open confrontation with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva following the rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the STF. They expect Alcolumbre to endorse the support of União and PP for Senator Flávio Dino, opting for negotiation over rupture with the government.

item.title: Sem Lula, esquerda fragmenta atos de 1º de Maio e reforça embate após veto a Messias
item.description: Left-wing movements are organizing fragmented May Day actions to pressure for the end of the 6x1 work scale, following recent defeats of Lula's government in Congress. The mobilization occurs amid internal divisions and reinforces opposition to the veto on Messias, highlighting the fragmentation of the Brazilian left amid growing government weariness.

item.title: Novo Desenrola Brasil terá FGTS, desconto de até 90% e bloqueio de bets: o que Lula anunciou
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced a new phase of the Desenrola Brasil program, offering discounts of up to 90% on credit card, overdraft, revolving credit, personal loan, and FIES debts, along with the ability to withdraw up to 20% of FGTS funds to pay off debt. The initiative includes interest rates as low as 1.99% per month and a one-year ban on online betting platforms for participants, aiming to reduce household indebtedness, which affects 80.4% of Brazilian families.

item.title: Flávio visita Bolsonaro após derrubada do veto à dosimetria
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) visited former President Jair Bolsonaro after Congress overturned Lula’s veto on the Dosimetry Bill, which reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks. Bolsonaro celebrated the decision, which could reduce his sentence from 27 years and 3 months to 20 years and 8 months, also benefiting 849 others. Flávio emphasized his father’s gratitude to loyal lawmakers and highlighted the unity of the bolsonarist base.

item.title: Moraes dá 48 horas para ‘Débora do Batom’ explicar falhas em tornozeleira eletrônica
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes gave Débora Rodrigues dos Santos, known as 'Débora do Batom', 48 hours to explain GPS failures in her electronic ankle monitor. She is serving a 14-year sentence under house arrest since September 2025 for her role in the January 8 coup attempt. The case has become a symbol of Bolsonarist pressure for amnesty for those involved in the attacks on the three branches of government.

item.title: Veto de Lula a projeto que reduz pena de Bolsonaro é derrubado com votos de partidos com ministérios
item.description: President Lula's veto to a bill that would reduce Jair Bolsonaro's sentence was overturned by Congress, with decisive support from centrist parties holding ministries in his government, such as PSD and União Brasil. The vote reveals the fragility of Lula's PT-led coalition amid parliamentary pressures and political bargains.

item.title: Líder do PT diz que base do governo vai recorrer ao STF após derrubada do veto ao PL da Dosimetria
item.description: PT leader Pedro Uczai announced the government base will seek judicial review after Congress overturned Lula’s veto on the dosimetry bill, which reduces sentences for January 8 attackers and benefits Jair Bolsonaro. The veto was overturned following a procedural maneuver by Congress President Davi Alcolumbre to avoid conflict with the Anti-Faction Law. PT critics denounced a 'backroom deal' between opposition and centrals, warning the move could aid criminal faction leaders.

item.title: Imprensa internacional repercute redução de pena de Bolsonaro e destaca relação 'frágil' de Lula com Congresso
item.description: International press highlighted that Brazil's Congress overturned President Lula's veto on a bill reducing sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, benefiting former President Jair Bolsonaro, marking the government's second defeat in 24 hours. Outlets including The Guardian, La Nación, The Washington Post, and El País emphasized that this exposes the fragility of Lula's relationship with a predominantly conservative Congress ahead of the October elections. The potential challenge in the Supreme Court and its electoral implications were widely noted.

item.title: Lula anuncia novo Desenrola para a próxima semana com até 20% do FGTS
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced the launch of the New Desenrola Brasil program for next Monday, offering discounts of up to 90% on debts and allowing the use of up to 20% of the FGTS to settle debts. The program includes a one-year ban on online betting platforms for participants and aims to ease family budgets, particularly for high-cost debts like credit cards and overdrafts. Lula also reiterated the end of the 6x1 work scale as a historic step, proposing a 40-hour workweek with two days off and no salary reduction.

item.title: Em pronunciamento, Lula confirma Desenrola 2 com saque do FGTS e veto a bets por 1 ano
item.description: President Lula confirmed Desenrola 2, allowing FGTS use for debt renegotiation, with a one-year ban on sports betting sites for participants, as a measure to curb spending on gambling.

item.title: Veja íntegra do pronunciamento de Lula pelo Dia do Trabalho
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will deliver a national radio and TV address on Thursday (30) for Labor Day. He is expected to announce details of the new Desenrola program, aimed at reducing household debt.

item.title: Lula anuncia novo Desenrola com desconto de até 90%, saque do FGTS para pagar dívidas e veto a bets
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced the New Desenrola Brasil debt renegotiation program, offering discounts of up to 90% and capping interest rates at 1.99% per month, allowing withdrawal of up to 20% from the FGTS fund and banning access to betting platforms for one year for participants. He also highlighted a proposal to reduce the weekly workweek to 40 hours, end the 6×1 shift pattern, and noted government actions to mitigate international conflict impacts on fuel and food prices.

item.title: Augusto Cury: por que o escritor mais lido do país decidiu ser candidato à Presidência?
item.description: Augusto Cury, Brazil's most-read author and Avante party's pre-candidate for president, decided to enter politics to bring his psychological and educational ideas into government, aiming to transform society through the human mind. He states that leaving the world of books to run for the Presidency was driven by the urgency to solve the country's structural problems based on emotional intelligence and ethics.

item.title: Recado ao ‘andar de cima’, Desenrola 2.0 e escala 6×1: o que Lula disse em pronunciamento na TV
item.description: President Lula announced the launch of Desenrola 2.0, a debt renegotiation program that will block participants from online betting platforms for one year. He also reiterated support for ending the 6×1 work schedule, criticized the 'elite from above' for historically opposing workers' rights, and cited the economic impacts of the Middle East conflict, highlighting fuel tax cuts as a government measure to mitigate the crisis.

item.title: Leia a íntegra e assista ao vídeo do discurso do 1º de Maio de Lula
item.description: President Lula announced the Novo Desenrola Brasil program, allowing debt renegotiation with interest capped at 1.99% and discounts up to 90%, alongside a one-year ban on online betting platforms for participants. He also reiterated the proposal to reduce the workweek to 40 hours with two days off, without salary reduction, as a measure to ease household indebtedness and honor workers, particularly women.

item.title: Lula diz que Novo Desenrola será lançado na segunda: quem aderir ficará bloqueado por um ano nas bets
item.description: President Lula announced that the Novo Desenrola Brasil program will be launched on Monday, with approximately R$ 100 billion in debts eligible for renegotiation. Participants who join the program will be barred from placing bets on online gambling sites for one year. The initiative aims to reduce national indebtedness and was announced in a national broadcast.

item.title: Cid sobre Lula: “Faltou espírito republicano na indicação”
item.description: Senator Cid Gomes (PSB-CE) criticized President Lula's nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court, calling it a 'joke' and stating that republican spirit was lacking in the process. He said the outcome was foreseeable, given previous concessions made by the Senate to the Executive in judicial appointments.

item.title: Lula discursa contra o “sistema” em cadeia nacional
item.description: President Lula (PT) delivered a national broadcast blaming the 'system' for workers' hardships, criticizing prevailing economic structures. He announced the end of the 6×1 work schedule and a new phase of the Desenrola Brasil program to reduce household and corporate debt. The tone was combative, reinforcing his narrative of confrontation with dominant economic elites.

item.title: Em pronunciamento na TV e no rádio, Lula defende fim da escala 6×1 e ‘ataca’ sistema
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defended in a national broadcast the end of the 6×1 work scale, stating it would guarantee more time for family, health, education, and rest, especially for women. He also announced the new Desenrola Brasil package, including debt renegotiation for credit cards and FIES, 20% FGTS withdrawal, and a one-year ban on online betting platforms for participants. Lula criticized the Brazilian elite for historically opposing workers' rights, arguing that such advances strengthen the economy.

item.title: Lula anuncia medidas para reduzir nível de endividamento; pacote inclui descontos de até 90% nas dívidas e uso de 20% do FGTS
item.description: President Lula announced a package of measures to reduce household and corporate debt, including up to 90% discounts on debt renegotiation through a new phase of the Desenrola program, access to up to 20% of FGTS funds for debt repayment, and a one-year ban on online betting platforms for participants. He also reiterated his proposal to reduce the workweek from 44 to 40 hours with a 5-day work schedule, arguing it would allow more time for family, health, and personal development. Full details will be released on Monday (4).

item.title: Lula diz na TV que lançará na segunda-feira 'Novo Desenrola Brasil' e dá detalhes do programa
item.description: President Lula announced the 'New Desenrola Brazil' debt renegotiation program, featuring interest rates capped at 1.99% per month, discounts of 40% to 90%, and permission to use up to 20% of FGTS funds to settle debts. The program targets individuals earning up to five minimum wages with overdue debts between 90 days and two years, with renegotiations conducted directly at banks and repayment terms extending up to four years. Aimed at alleviating household debt—now at a record 29.7% of income—the initiative seeks to boost Lula’s popularity amid widespread perception of insufficient income to cover expenses.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula faz pronunciamento pelo Dia do Trabalhador
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will deliver a radio and television address at 8:30 p.m. on Thursday, April 30, 2026, to mark Workers' Day, focusing on the launch of Desenrola 2, which promises up to 90% discounts on debt renegotiation, and the end of the 6x1 work schedule. The Liberal Party has filed a petition with the TSE to prevent Lula from using the address for personal promotion, linking his image to public policies, or criticizing political opponents.

item.title: Lindbergh diz que vai ao STF contra o PL da Dosimetria
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) announced he will take the congressional override of Lula's veto on the Dosimetria bill to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), calling it unconstitutional. He argues the law benefits specific individuals, weakens penal protections, and violates separation of powers, particularly by reducing sentences for January 8th rioters — potentially cutting Jair Bolsonaro’s sentence from over 27 years to about 2 years and 4 months.

item.title: Faltou espírito republicano na indicação de Messias, diz Cid Gomes
item.description: Senator Cid Gomes (PSB-CE) stated that he knew Jorge Messias did not have more than 35 votes in the Senate for STF approval and that the nomination lacked republican spirit by President Lula (PT). He criticized the choice as unsuitable for such a high office.

item.title: Moraes autoriza que Bolsonaro se interne na 6ª feira para cirurgia
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to be hospitalized on Friday, May 1, 2026, at DF Star Hospital in Brasília for right shoulder surgery. Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years and 3 months in prison for attempted coup, has been under temporary humanitarian house arrest since March 27 due to health conditions. His defense requested authorization for all treatment phases, supported by orthopedic reports confirming a high-grade lesion.

item.title: TSE mantém cassação de deputada do PL por usar dinheiro público para harmonização facial
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously upheld the removal from office of federal deputy Silvia Nobre Lopes (PL-AP), known as Silvia Waiãpi, for using public campaign funds to pay for a facial harmonization procedure during the 2022 elections. The ruling, issued on Thursday, confirms the complaint filed by the then-campaign coordinator, who alleged the illegal use of electoral resources for personal benefit.

item.title: Como ficam imposto sobre gasolina, Desenrola 2 e 6x1 depois do atropelamento de Lula 3
item.description: The analysis points out congressional resistance to approving projects that directly benefit the public, even when popular, such as fuel tax cuts, debt renegotiation programs (Desenrola), and a 6x1 workweek. This contradiction between popular interest and parliamentary voting raises questions about representativeness and the interests influencing legislative decisions following the alleged Lula 3 hit-and-run incident.

item.title: André Mendonça ajudou ou atrapalhou Messias?
item.description: André Mendonça publicly supported Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF despite their political differences, praising his character and shared evangelical faith. However, this support failed to prevent Messias's rejection by the Senate, which was influenced by Davi Alcolumbre's behind-the-scenes opposition and the secret vote, undermining Mendonça's strategy to secure conservative senatorial backing.

item.title: Lula sofre derrotas com Messias e dosimetria mesmo após ter liberado R$ 10,9 bilhões em emendas
item.description: The Lula government suffered two defeats in Congress: the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court and the overturning of the veto on the dosimetry project, despite releasing R$10.9 billion in parliamentary amendments over the last three weeks — 82% of the total authorized this year. The effort included a 'mutirão' of amendment processing during Messias’ hearing, targeting senators like Weverton Rocha and Davi Alcolumbre, but failed to prevent the losses.

item.title: Alcolumbre dá recado a Lula com derrota de Messias: ‘Você precisa mais de mim do que eu de você’
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre celebrated the rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF, claiming the Lula government needs him more than he needs the government, after securing backing from bolsonarists to block the nomination. He framed the outcome as an exercise of power and a direct message to Lula, asserting that the president cannot take away what he has achieved.

item.title: Oposição celebra derrubada do veto de Lula à dosimetria; veja vídeo
item.description: Congress overturned President Lula's veto on the dosimetry bill, allowing sentence reductions for those convicted of the January 8, 2023, coup attempts. The measure directly benefits former president Jair Bolsonaro, whose son Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated as a 2026 presidential pre-candidate. The vote was 318-144 in the Chamber and 49-24 in the Senate, with the rapporteur estimating a 6-year-and-7-month reduction in Bolsonaro's sentence.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a realizar nova cirurgia
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to undergo a new right shoulder surgery, with hospitalization permitted starting May 1, 2026. Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years and three months for leading the coup plot, is serving his sentence under temporary house arrest. The authorization followed a favorable opinion from the General Prosecutor's Office and a medical request due to pain during movement.

item.title: Mendonça vai relatar ação no STF contra o projeto do governo que acaba com a escala 6×1
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça will report on a mandado de segurança filed by Deputy Ricardo Salles (Novo-SP) against the Brazilian government's urgent bill to end the 6×1 work scale. Salles claims the urgency request is unjustified and incompatible with the issue's complexity, accusing the government of undermining the legislative process in an election year. The government proposes replacing the 6×1 scale with a 5×2 model (two days off weekly) without salary reduction, while two PECs on reducing the workweek from 44 to 36 hours are already under committee review.

item.title: Congresso derruba veto a PL da Dosimetria e Flávio prevê ‘fim do governo’ Lula
item.description: Congress overturned President Lula's veto on a bill reducing sentences for those convicted of coup-related acts, including Bolsonaro, marking another governmental defeat. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a presidential pre-candidate, declared that the earlier rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination would be the 'end of Lula's government'. These events highlight the opposition's growing offensive against the executive.

item.title: Alcolumbre ironiza imprensa: “Vocês sabem de mais coisa do que eu”
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) declined to comment on his alleged role in the articulation that led to the defeat of Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Court, responding with irony to journalists by saying 'you know more than I do'.

item.title: Zema convoca ‘panelaço’ contra Lula
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) called for a 'panelaço' on social media against President Lula's upcoming address scheduled for Thursday, the 30th, at 8:30 p.m. In an AI-produced video, Zema urged Brazilians to 'rekindle the outrage' that led to Dilma Rousseff's impeachment, framing the act as opposition to the current government. The call was first reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: TSE diz não haver previsão legal para candidaturas coletivas
item.description: The TSE stated there is no legal provision for collective candidacies in Brazil, emphasizing that the electoral process is based on individual candidacy. Relator Isabel Gallotti voted not to analyze the request, arguing the topic lacks legal basis and a response could lead to multiple interpretations. Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques dissented, but the leading vote reaffirmed no legal basis for collective candidacies, while noting a group may be represented by a single person before Electoral Justice.

item.title: TSE rejeita recurso e confirma cassação de Silvia Waiãpi, deputada indígena apoiadora de Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE unanimously upheld the cassation of indigenous deputy Silvia Waiãpi (PL-AP) for using R$ 9,000 in public campaign funds (FEFC) to pay for a facial aesthetic procedure during the 2022 campaign, falsifying an invoice to conceal the illicit expense. The ruling confirms the TRE-AP’s decision, ordering the nullification of her votes, vote recount, and recalculation of electoral and party quotients.

item.title: Derrubar Dosimetria perdoa quem planejou assassinatos, diz PT
item.description: The national president of the PT, Edinho Silva, criticized the overturning of President Lula's veto on the Dosimetria Bill, claiming it pardons those who planned assassinations and constitutes a democratic setback. He argued that Congress is turning its back on society and weakening the legal order by reducing sentences for those responsible for the January 8, 2023, coup attempts, which benefit former President Jair Bolsonaro and 849 others convicted.

item.title: Messias e PL da Dosimetria incendeiam direita e esquerda no caldeirão das redes sociais
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF and the overturning of Lula's vetoes on the Dosimetria Bill triggered massive social media mobilization, with the right celebrating these as blows to Lula's government and boosting Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential campaign, while the left condemned the Senate as anti-democratic and pushed for a Black woman to be nominated to the STF.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a se internar amanhã para fazer nova cirurgia
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to be admitted tomorrow to DF Star Hospital in Brasília for surgery on his right shoulder. The decision followed a medical request and complied with legal requirements. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Lula confirma mudanças nas misturas de etanol na gasolina para 32% e do biodiesel no diesel para 16%
item.description: President Lula announced an increase in the mandatory blend of anhydrous ethanol in gasoline from 30% to 32% and biodiesel in diesel from 15% to 16%, with an initial validity of 180 days, extendable. The measure aims to reduce dependence on imported fuels, enhance energy security, and move toward gasoline self-sufficiency, with an estimated reduction of 500 million liters per month in external purchases.
